what: LONG-TAIL BATCH F, STEP 5 — a fainted body's ability is ignored, so a Pickpocket that died to the contact hit steals nothing.
written: 2026-09-06, BEFORE the measuring run, by ENGINE.
how_it_was_found: It was REVEALED by step 4, not present before it. The game that carried the White Herb ordering re-parted on this row the moment the ordering closed — diffed game by game out of divergence-turns-F3/F4: seed gen9championsvgc2026regmbbo3-2660048410 was relabelled from `ordering :: |-enditem|p1b|whiteherb <> |detailschange|p2a|raichumegay,l50` to `extra event emitted by medicham2 :: |move|p2a|waterfall <> |-enditem|p2b|widelens|[from]pickpocket`.
the_rule: Pickpocket's own handler (data/abilities.ts:3230) has NO hp or fainted test. The refusal is one level up: runEvent skips an Ability handler when `effectHolder.ignoringAbility()`, and `ignoringAbility()` opens `if (this.battle.gen >= 5 && !this.isActive) return true;` (sim/pokemon.ts). `faintMessages` sets `pokemon.isActive = false` (sim/battle.ts:2564). So every ability handler on a corpse is skipped, `End` alone excepted.
why_it_only_appeared_now: Batch E moved the Pickpocket payment from the per-hit reaction block to the authority's own position, AfterMoveSecondary at sim/battle-actions.ts:1005, which is BELOW faintMessages at scripts.ts:547. That fix is correct and it is what put the handler on a dead body for the first time.
probe: tests/probe_pickpocket_on_a_corpse.js, knob MEDI_PICKPOCKET_ON_A_CORPSE. Shown RED first: the authority steals 0 times from a corpse and 1 time from the same thief when a weaker contact move leaves it alive; medicham2 steals in BOTH.
which_scoreboard: THE POOL. Pickpocket is 175 sheets and the artifact carries one board-parted row. The census and roster should sit still — no tag changes.
why_it_might_miss_HIGH: The same game has now re-parted twice in two steps. If it carries a third cause behind this one it will stay in the board column and board-material will read 35 again — that is exactly what happened at step 4 and it is the mechanism to expect.
why_it_might_miss_LOW: The instrument-suspect `|-enditem|p1b|roseliberry|[eat]` and `|-enditem|p2b|mentalherb` rows are a different family and are not expected to move.
